source.test: rules.root-toolbar exposes the root commands end to end

steps.title: 锁定空树初态，避免把残留 profile 数据误判为 toolbar 行为。 / Lock the empty-tree baseline so persisted profile data cannot mask the flow.
新建 rule 后应打开其 editor，并允许导出当前非空草稿树。 / Creating a rule opens its editor and enables export for the non-empty draft tree.
填写规则名称 / Enter the Rule name
填写Host匹配条件 / Enter the Host condition
在条件菜单中选择Path / Choose Path from the condition menu
填写本次请求的Path范围 / Enter the request Path scope
填写请求Header名称 / Enter the request Header name
填写请求Header值 / Enter the request Header value
启用完整规则，尚未保存 / Enable the complete Rule before saving
保存当前规则配置 / Save the current Rule configuration
在Capture选中/e2e/rules/actions/request-set / Select /e2e/rules/actions/request-set in Capture
Capture中的request Header set结果 / The request Header set result in Capture
request Header执行set / set the request Header
保存前的request Header append配置 / The request Header append configuration before saving
Capture中的request Header append结果 / The request Header append result in Capture
保存前的request Header remove配置 / The request Header remove configuration before saving
Capture中的request Header remove结果 / The request Header remove result in Capture
已选择response Header阶段 / Select the response Header phase
保存前的response Header set配置 / The response Header set configuration before saving
Capture中的response Header set结果 / The response Header set result in Capture
保存前的response Header append配置 / The response Header append configuration before saving
Capture中的response Header append结果 / The response Header append result in Capture
保存前的response Header remove配置 / The response Header remove configuration before saving
Capture中的response Header remove结果 / The response Header remove result in Capture
打开动作菜单并定位rules.action.query / Locate rules.action.query in the action menu
填写Query替换值rewritten / Enter Query replacement value rewritten
保存当前规则配置 / Save the current Rule configuration
Capture中查看Query set的入站参数 / Inspect the incoming Query set parameters in Capture
响应echo显示实际entry=rewritten / The response echo shows the forwarded entry=rewritten
选择Query remove / Select Query remove
保存当前规则配置 / Save the current Rule configuration
Capture中查看Query remove的入站参数 / Inspect the incoming Query remove parameters in Capture
响应echo显示移除Query后的实际路径 / The response echo shows the path after Query removal
打开动作菜单并定位rules.action.status / Locate rules.action.status in the action menu
填写响应状态418 / Enter response status 418
保存当前规则配置 / Save the current Rule configuration
Capture中核对状态改写418 / Inspect status 418 in Capture
打开动作菜单并定位rules.action.synthetic / Locate rules.action.synthetic in the action menu
填写模拟响应状态503 / Enter synthetic response status 503
填写模拟响应正文 / Enter the synthetic response body
填写模拟响应Header值 / Enter the synthetic response Header value
保存当前规则配置 / Save the current Rule configuration
Capture中核对模拟响应503 / Inspect the synthetic response status 503 in Capture
Capture中核对模拟响应Header / Inspect the synthetic response Header in Capture
Capture中核对模拟响应正文 / Inspect the synthetic response body in Capture
打开动作菜单并定位rules.action.delay / Locate rules.action.delay in the action menu
填写500毫秒Delay / Enter a 500 millisecond Delay
保存当前规则配置 / Save the current Rule configuration
Capture Timing显示本次Delay请求的等待 / Capture Timing shows the wait for this delayed request
添加rules.action.block后的初始字段 / Initial fields after adding rules.action.block
Capture中查看Block reset失败请求 / Inspect the failed Block reset request in Capture
将Block切换为close / Switch Block to close
Capture中查看Block close失败请求 / Inspect the failed Block close request in Capture
保存当前规则配置 / Save the current Rule configuration
Capture中核对Block停用后的200 / Inspect status 200 after disabling Block in Capture
打开动作菜单并定位rules.action.map-remote / Locate rules.action.map-remote in the action menu
填写Map Remote目标Path / Enter the Map Remote target Path
保存当前规则配置 / Save the current Rule configuration
Capture保留Map Remote的原入口请求 / Capture retains the original Map Remote entry request
Capture显示HTTP目标返回的映射正文 / Capture shows the mapped body returned by the HTTP target
保存当前规则配置 / Save the current Rule configuration
在Capture中选择要保存的响应正文 / Select the source response body in Capture
选择本次文件位置 / Choose this operation’s file location
打开动作菜单并定位rules.action.map-local / Locate rules.action.map-local in the action menu
填写不存在的Map Local文件名 / Enter a nonexistent Map Local file name
启用Map Local，准备保存 / Enable Map Local before saving
Capture中核对本地文件缺失404 / Inspect the missing local file status 404 in Capture
将Local path改为刚保存的文件 / Correct Local path to the file just saved
保存当前规则配置 / Save the current Rule configuration
Capture中核对本地文件映射200 / Inspect the mapped local file status 200 in Capture
Capture中核对产品保存文件返回的正文 / Inspect the body returned from the product-saved file in Capture
将Content-Encoding填写为gzip / Enter gzip as Content-Encoding
Capture中查看仅改写的Content-Encoding / Inspect the Header-only Content-Encoding change in Capture
Capture显示原字节及gzip解码提示 / Capture shows the original bytes and gzip decoding notice
保留编码Header并选择Body动作 / Choose Body while retaining the encoding Header
填写显式替换的响应正文 / Enter the explicit replacement response body
保存当前规则配置 / Save the current Rule configuration
Capture中核对gzip响应Header和长度 / Inspect gzip response Headers and length in Capture
Capture中查看真正gzip响应的解码正文 / Inspect the decoded body of the real gzip response in Capture
保存当前规则配置 / Save the current Rule configuration
Capture中核对最终停用后的原始响应 / Inspect the original response after final disabling in Capture
